## Overview
The legal parent company. A **minimal identity for legal documents only**: letterhead, contracts, invoices,
purchase orders, statutory notices, NDAs. It is not a marketing brand and never appears in campaigns,
product UI or social. Product brands carry the legal name only in footers and legal lines.

## Colors
One placeholder ink ramp. Documents are near-monochrome: text, rules and the legal mark.

## Typography
The shared family (not chosen yet). Body and caption roles cover almost every legal document.

## Layout
A4 portrait first. Margins, letterhead block and footer legal line: open.

## Do's and Don'ts
- Do keep it plain, legible and printable in black and white.
- Don't add imagery, accent colours or product names.
